meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你浏览、选择并提交 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上的实验方案，包括蛋白表达纯化、定量、IVT RNA 合成、热稳定性分析等，还能通过 EstiMate 询问定制方案的价格和可行性。
howto.when: 当你想在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上运行蛋白表达、定量、RNA 合成、酶活检测等实验，或需要了解方案价格和流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看有哪些蛋白表达方案？
say.note: Claude 会列出可用方案及价格。

say.text: 我想做细胞-free 的蛋白表达和纯化，怎么下单？
say.note: Claude 会引导选择方案并说明下单步骤。

say.text: 用 EstiMate 评估一个定制实验的可行性。
say.note: Claude 会引导你描述实验并获取评估。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you browse, select, and submit protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, including protein expression/purification, quantification, IVT RNA synthesis, thermal shift assays, etc. It can also use EstiMate to get feasibility and pricing for custom workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run experiments on Ginkgo Cloud Lab (e.g., protein expression, quantification, RNA synthesis, enzyme assays) or need information about protocol pricing and ordering workflow.

say_en.text: What protein expression protocols are available?
say_en.note: Claude lists available protocols with prices.

say_en.text: How do I order cell-free protein expression and purification?
say_en.note: Claude guides you through protocol selection and ordering steps.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to assess feasibility of a custom experiment.
say_en.note: Claude helps you describe the experiment and get an assessment.
